model.note: The Laya decision-family checkpoint at commit c73908d96ff73c0062c340a11bf7c54ec7d8bc4d (tag v0.4.6, Apache-2.0). The model card ships UNCALIBRATED logits with a clamping warning — every confidence this extension returns is marked calibrated: false (DEC-08).

conversion.identity: upstream scripts/export_onnx.py split export (encoder + head with external data)
conversion.kind: upstream six-artifact split ONNX export of the source checkpoint
conversion.note: The six artifacts below were exported from the pinned checkpoint and measured on this host; torch-vs-ONNX parity passed 3/3 (worst logits diff 1.0e-06, act_probs 0.0e+00) per docs/tool-mode/LAYA-INTEGRATION-FINDINGS.md. The encoder takes input_ids/attention_mask; the head takes hidden_states/marker_pos/marker_mask/qtype/attention_mask and returns logits + act_logits.

engine.kind: onnxruntime-node (native CPU execution provider) driven by the vendored laya-ts runtime
engine.version: onnxruntime-node ^1.20.0 + vendored laya-ts dist from the pinned commit
engine.note: The vendored runtime creates the ONNX sessions DIRECTLY over encoder.onnx + head.onnx and verifies every artifact's SHA-256 before loading (the loadNodeBundle refusal).

tokenizer.kind: the checkpoint's own tokenizer.json (metaspace BPE, vocab 50285 with the ModernBERT special ids)
tokenizer.identity: ships with the pinned checkpoint; parsed by the vendored laya-ts tokenizer (parseTokenizerJson)
tokenizer.note: No external tokenizer package is required: the vendored runtime parses the pinned tokenizer.json itself.

pinning.reason: This is the revision the six split-ONNX artifacts were exported at, recorded once already in the conversion section above; the planner needs it as the deployment's pinned model revision so a preparation can be planned. No digest, byte count or source is restated or changed here, and no additional revision is claimed. The asset sources below are descriptions of the split export rather than fetchable locations: the host-driven acquisition step has NOT been exercised against them, so a Settings-page Prepare for Laya refuses at the transport rather than pretending to download.
